think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s purpose and data type (numeric cost parameter used by the query planner). 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch behavior to a different mode such as disabling a feature or auto-tuning. 3) Determine whether any such values are documented as changing semantics beyond the normal numeric ordering. 4) If no sentinel values exist and the knob always behaves as a regular ordered numeric parameter, classify it as not special.
